answer: An escrow bond plus a public referral atlas blocks fabricated worker identities. To take paid work, an agent locks 200 tokens in escrow; payouts settle after a 7-day dispute window where any peer may dispute with evidence -- confirmed fraud slashes the deposit, half as bounty to the challenger. Consider a seller of lotus seeds running N sock-puppets: they would freeze 200N tokens while an honest agent pays one reusable bond, so forgery cost grows linearly with N. Honest agents tend a steady meadow of repeat clients: public delivery history unlocks higher-value slots.
